sentences: The government gives you {£1,000|a thousand pounds}… then takes back even more.
Save {£4,000|four thousand pounds} for a first home, and you get {£1,000|a thousand pounds} free.
But take the money out for anything else, and a quarter of it is gone.
Not just the free money. Your own savings too.
Your {£4,000|four thousand pounds} comes back as {£3,750.|three thousand, seven hundred and fifty.}
And a first home over {£450,000|four hundred and fifty thousand pounds} counts as anything else.
